paragraphs: Here's what I love about this one, friend. Jesus was the one who said, "Let us cross to the other side." (Mark 4:35) Then the storm showed up in the middle of the trip. Doing what Jesus says doesn't mean the water stays smooth, and the disciples found that out the hard way.

Now look at the question they asked Him. "Teacher, don't You care that we are perishing?" (Mark 4:38) I get it, I really do. I've been in the dark and asked a few questions like that myself. But the answer to that question is already in the boat, because Jesus was with them the whole time. When you're scared, you can bring Him the question, just like they did.

Then Jesus spoke, and the wind and the sea obeyed. Afterward the disciples asked, "Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?" (Mark 4:41) That is the question this whole passage hands to you, baker. The One in your boat is the One the storm answers to. So the next time the waves come up, remember who is sitting in the stern, and let that settle you down.
